sentence: This project tests whether peer-led motivational interviewing helps people who use drugs use drug checking services and reduce overdose.
This project studies how genetic, clinical, biological, and environmental factors in early life shape food allergy and atopic dermatitis in children.
This project tests how iron moves through and harms the retina, and whether a drug can stop that harm.
This project measures how cells in a community differ in metabolism and how those differences help the population adapt in dynamic microenvironments.
This project works with parents of children with cancer to build and test an electronic health record tool for communication with clinicians.
This project designs and makes compounds that block an enzyme class that lets bacteria resist drugs, and tests them with antibiotics.
This project studies which parts of emergency department readiness for children help injured children survive longer.
This project studies how hematopoietic stem cells are regulated and how hematologic malignancies relate to the bone microenvironment.
This project studies how DNA elements interact in gene regulation, using CRISPR-based tools and deep learning.
This project uses a rodent malaria model to improve the formulation of a vaccine against malaria caused by Plasmodium falciparum.
This project looks for genes needed for male fertility by sequencing infertile patients and controls and testing the genes in mice.
This project builds a shared hub that stores and analyzes behavioral and neural data to link neural dynamics with behavior in substance use disorders.
This project builds deep learning tools that use medical imaging and electronic health record data to predict liver disease risk.
This project studies how one molecule affects neurodegeneration in aging brains, using single cells and 3D cerebral organoids.
This project uses deep learning and modeling to design reagents that detect two glycans linked to disease.
This project studies the structure of a region of the HIV envelope protein and of antibodies that bind it.
This project tests a computer method that uses a CT scan to pick the dose and place for injecting cisplatin into a lung tumor.
This project studies how sex and cell death shape liver injury caused by immune checkpoint inhibitors in cancer treatment.
This project builds an ecosystem that develops and tests technologies and artificial intelligence for the care of frail older adults.
